title: Hemoptysis as a named symptom, not a species
dek: Wikipedia's coughing-blood page is a symptom index. Cavities transmit; the word does not speciate or dose.
story: Hemoptysis on Wikipedia is a symptom: expectorated blood from below the larynx. TB cavities, bronchiectasis, cancer, and aspergilloma sit on the differential list.
In a TB studio the word matters because cavitary disease drives smear grade and transmission. That is already a pathogenesis/transmission lesson. This card is the search string.
Massive hemoptysis is an airway emergency. Encyclopedia first-aid is not a bronchoscopy protocol.
deep: Rasmussen aneurysm folklore is a vascular complication of cavities — pointer, not a radiology SOP.
Smear-negative hemoptysis still needs a work-up.
Do not start HRZE from the word alone without a diagnostic class.
Infection control: blood-stained sputum is still sputum.

visual.caption: Symptom in the middle of a differential. TB is a celebrity cause, not the only one.
